fields.description: Belmont Residences is Ellington’s mid-rise apartment development in Jumeirah Village Triangle. Studios and larger homes surround shared recreation spaces, with several layouts offering terraces or study rooms.

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Belmont body, investment guide and plan cover checked; unrelated La Mer global hero excluded. No completion assumed from old forecast.
reviewCoverage.location: Own project body and guide identify Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. District 4 is portal context, not an invented plot coordinate.
reviewCoverage.residences: Guide confirms 10 studios, 29 one-bedroom and 29 two-bedroom apartments. All twelve plan panels examined; erroneous 2BR label on one-bedroom drawing disclosed.
reviewCoverage.areas: Plan pages 4–9 visually read at 1700 px, all twelve numerical layout panels. Totals, outdoor areas and source arithmetic conflicts retained.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own body and guide amenities reviewed; marketing concepts do not independently confirm facilities operating today.
reviewCoverage.pricing: PF currently advertises AED 850000 lowest listed reference and separate historical type guides. No own dated current price list verified.
reviewCoverage.payment: One-page branded launch plan visually inspected;20+10+10+6x5+30=100. Final30 at completion differs PF post-handover label; no combined current offer.
reviewCoverage.handover: PF December 2024 is elapsed forecast; own owner manual and construction gallery do not establish actual individual key date or current stock. Handover null.
reviewCoverage.documents: Guide, plans and payment PDF public derivations pooled200: guide30/plans105/payment65. Grouped total-area rows remove duplicated outdoor labels and repeated payment prose; all original variants and numeric conflicts retained.

overview: Guide: 68 homes; one parking space each. Its AED 14/ft² service-charge figure is an estimate, not an approved current levy.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. The unrelated La Mer villa header on the developer’s template is excluded.
research.priceLabel: Portal advertised reference · confirm selected listing
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s headline advertises AED 850,000; its developer studio table separately retains AED 759,000 and labels developer types out of stock. These are different references, not a verified current developer allocation or binding unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Historical document terms; Property Finder instead calls the final 30% post-handover. Confirm the applicable agreement.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder retains December 2024 as its expected completion. Ellington publishes an owner handover manual and later construction-gallery entries, but these do not establish the selected unit’s actual handover date or a completion certificate. No elapsed forecast is presented as current off-plan availability.
